headline: Olympics.com publishes India’s full medal tally and winners list for the 2026 Commonwealth Games, detailing the number of gold, silver and bronze medals secured across all disciplines.

Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya reiterated India’s aggressive strategy to host the 2036 Olympic Games, outlining new infrastructure projects and international lobbying efforts in a recent press briefing.
Olympics.com highlights India’s top track‑and‑field record holders, showcasing athletes who currently own national marks in events such as javelin, 800 m and long jump.
